arXiv:2608.13433v1 [cs.FL] 2026 年 8 月 13 日arXiv:2608.13433v1 [cs.FL] 13 Aug 2026

变压器代数分解理论Algebraic Decomposition Theory for Transformer
长度概括Length Generalization

Andy Yang    Blerta Veseli Thanks: AY and BV are co-first authors. Contact: ayang4@nd.edu,{blerta.veseli,mhahn}@uni-saarland.de    Corentin Barloy    Michaël Cadilhac    Andreas Krebs    Charles Paperman    Howard Straubing Affiliation: DePaul University, University of Tübingen, University of Lille, Boston College    Michael Hahn    [1ex] University of Notre Dame    Saarland University    Ruhr University Bochum
摘要Abstract

众所周知，基于 Transformer 的语言模型有时会泛化到比训练期间看到的更长的序列，但我们缺乏对哪些任务允许长度泛化的精确描述。 甚至不知道是哪一个Transformer-based language models are known to sometimes generalize to sequences longer than seen during training, but we lack a precise characterization of which tasks admit length generalization. It is not even known which常规语言regular languages变形金刚的长度概括——这是语言的基础类别。 我们的贡献是建立第一个完整的表征，常规语言转换器长度概括并提供在语言句法幺半群大小的多项式时间内运行的决策算法。 这些结果依赖于 C-RASP 中常规语言的有效表征，C-RASP 是一种最近建立的形式主义，用于表达转换器长度泛化的语言。 这种表征具有挑战性，因为有限半群的 Krohn-Rhodes 分解理论等经典工具对于 C-RASP 来说是不够的。 首先，Krohn-Rhodes 理论的基本构建模块——触发器和单群——无法在 C-RASP 中表达。 其次，C-RASP（无界计数）的基本构件不能用克罗恩-罗德理论的有限半群来表达。 因此，transformers length-generalize on – and this is a foundational class of languages. Our contributions are to establish the first complete characterization of which regular languages transformers length-generalize on and provide a decision algorithm running in polynomial time in the size of the language’s syntactic monoid. These results rely on an effective characterization of the regular languages in C-RASP, a recently-established formalism that expresses which languages transformers length-generalize on. This characterization is challenging because classical tools like Krohn-Rhodes decomposition theory for finite semigroups are insufficient for C-RASP. Firstly, the basic building blocks of Krohn-Rhodes theory – flip-flop and simple groups – are not expressible in C-RASP. Secondly, the basic building block of C-RASP (unbounded counting) is not expressible by the finite semigroups of Krohn-Rhodes theory. Thus,正则语言的长度泛化是由经典有限分解理论不可见的代数性质控制的。length generalization on regular languages is controlled by an algebraic property that is invisible to classical finite decomposition theory.我们将经典分解理论从有限半群推广到整数上的无限加法群，使我们能够根据整数的迭代花圈积来表征 C-RASP，并导出用于常规语言隶属度的可证明多项式时间决策算法。 在广泛的常规语言测试套件中进行的实验证实，我们的理论比现有的分类更准确地捕获了 Transformer 的长度泛化行为。We generalize classical decomposition theory from finite semigroups to the infinite additive group on the integers, allowing us to characterize C-RASP in terms of iterated wreath products of the integers and derive a provable polynomial-time decision algorithm for regular language membership. Experiments across a broad test suite of regular languages confirm that our theory captures transformers’ length-generalization behavior more accurately than existing classifications.11 1代码可在Code available atGitHub repository.

1 简介Introduction

Transformer 语言模型拥有哪些状态跟踪功能？ 为了回答这个问题我们研究What state-tracking capabilities do transformer language models possess? To answer this question we study the常规语言regular languages哪些变压器可以on which transformers can长度概括length-generalize。 首先，常规语言为我们提供了一个正式的框架来描述变压器可以实现的状态跟踪算法的结构。 其次，对长度泛化的探索为我们提供了一个经验证实，即变压器学习了底层算法的实现。 尽管这是一个关于重要架构的基本问题，但我们仍然缺乏准确的答案。 例如如图所示. First, regular languages give us a formal framework to describe the structure of state-tracking algorithms that transformers can implement. Second, probing for length-generalization gives us an empirical confirmation that the transformer learns an implementation of the underlying algorithm. Even though this is a fundamental question about an important architecture, we still lack a precise answer. For instance as shown infig. 1，两个结构相似的状态跟踪任务（识别, two structurally similar state-tracking tasks (recognizing(a​b+b​b​a​a)∗(ab+bbaa)^{*}和and(a​b+a​a​b​b)∗(ab+aabb)^{*}）在长度概括性方面可能会出现巨大分歧——并且所有现有理论都无法解释这种差异。) may diverge sharply in terms of length-generalizability – and all existing theory fails to explain this discrepancy.

这种探究在机器学习领域有着悠久的历史。 事实上，This line of inquiry has a deep history in machine learning. In fact,Kleene 1956专门为了分析 McCulloch-Pitts 神经网络的功能而发明了正则表达式。 常规语言识别是计算理论中的一项基本任务，它为我们提供了确定模型的序列处理能力的系统方法invented regular expressions specifically for the purpose of analyzing the capabilities of McCulloch-Pitts neural networks. Regular language recognition is a fundamental task in the theory of computation that provides us a systematic method of determining the sequence-processing capabilities of a model(Sipser 1996)。 任务很简单：给定一系列输入，每个输入都会触发确定性有限自动机 (DFA) 中的转换，在每次转换后跟踪机器的状态。 这些有限状态跟踪任务具体出现在语言模型的背景下，我们在下面概述。. The task is simple: given a sequence of inputs, each of which triggers a transition in a deterministic finite automaton (DFA), track the state of the machine after each transition. These finite state-tracking tasks arise concretely in the context of language models, which we sketch below.

约束解码：Constrained decoding:用户可能希望语言模型能够生成结构化格式的文本，例如 JSON 或代码，这可能会带来挑战A user may want a language model to generate text in a structured format, such as JSON or code, which can pose challenges(Schall & de Melo 2025)。 即使输出的长度不断增长，它们的结构化格式通常遵循常规约束（例如，将花括号与 JSON 中的固定深度相匹配）。. Even as outputs grow in length, their structured formats often follow regular constraints (e.g. matching curly braces to a fixed depth in JSON).

代理工作流程：Agentic workflows:实践中的人工智能代理遵循由动作组合序列组成的工作流程AI agents in practice follow workflows consisting of compositional sequences of actions(Schluntz & Zhang 2024)。 跟踪环境状态并决定下一步要采取的操作可以明确地视为模拟 DFA。. Keeping track of the state of the environment and deciding the next action to take can then explicitly be seen as simulating a DFA.

自然语言：Natural language:自然语言中的语素通常遵循可以通过常规语言建模的约束Morphemes in natural languages typically follow constraints that can be modeled by regular languages(Kaplan & Kay 1994)。 自然语言语义还涉及随着时间的推移维持不同所指对象的状态. Natural language semantics also involves maintaining the states of different referents over time(Kim & Schuster 2023).

Our core innovation is to develop an analogous algebraic decomposition theory for transformers using the additive group on the integers. 4.5 代数表征Algebraic Characterization

决策过程产生了常规语言的精确代数特征The decision procedure results an an exact algebraic characterization of the regular languages in𝖢​-​𝖱𝖠𝖲𝖯{\mathsf{C\text{-}RASP}}– 也就是说，它们是有界深度 Dyck 语言的花环产物。 因此，我们在围绕有限幺半群的类中得出一个小的层次结构– namely, they are wreath products of bounded-depth Dyck languages. We thus derive a small hierarchy within the classes of finite monoids surrounding𝖢​-​𝖱𝖠𝖲𝖯{\mathsf{C\text{-}RASP}}.

培训和评估。Training and Evaluation.

根据正式语言，我们使用从训练长度范围中采样的 10,000 个单词来训练 GPT-2 模型Per formal language, we train GPT-2 models on 10,000 words sampled from the training length range[lm​i​n,50][l_{min},50]与withlm​i​nl_{min}是相应语言中最短有效单词的长度。我们使用 80/20 的训练-测试分割。然后我们评估测试长度范围的泛化能力being the length of the shortest valid word in the respective language. We use an 80/20 train-test split. We then evaluate generalization on test length ranges[51,100],[101,150]​…​[451,500][51,100],[101,150]\dots[451,500]，每个测试集中有 1,000 个单词。我们将成功的长度泛化定义为在超出长度时保持接近分布的性能, with 1,000 words in each test set. We define successful length generalization as maintaining near in-distribution performance at lengths beyond2×2\times最大训练长度the maximum training length5050。正在关注. FollowingHuang et al. 2025我们使用 AdamW，权重衰减为 0.01，dropout 为 0.0。我们对各层执行了超参数扫描we used AdamW with weight decay 0.01 and dropout 0.0. We performed a hyperparameter sweep over layers{1,2,4}\{1,2,4\}, 头, heads{1,2,4}{\{1,2,4\}}, 维度, dimension{16,64,256}{\{16,64,256\}}和学习率and learning rates{0.001,0.0001}{\{0.001,0.0001\}}– 当分布测试数据达到 100% 准确度时，提前停止训练网格中的每个组合。对于那些分布内准确率从未达到 100% 的语言，我们还对各层执行了超参数扫描– training every combination in the grid with early stopping when 100% accuracy is achieved on in-distribution test data. For those languages, where in-distribution accuracy never reached 100%, we additionally performed a hyperparameter sweep over layers{6,8,12}{\{6,8,12\}}, 头, heads{4,8}{\{4,8\}}, 尺寸, dimensions{64,256}{\{64,256\}}和学习率and learning rates{0.001,0.0001}\{0.001,0.0001\}。我们采用了优化选择和超参数范围. We adopted optimization choices and hyperparameter ranges fromHuang et al. 2025。对于每种语言，我们选择在分布内长度准确度较高的配置中，在最长测试长度范围内实现最高准确度的配置. Per language, we choose the configuration that achieves the highest accuracy on the longest test length range among those whose accuracy on in-distribution length[lm​i​n,50][l_{min},50]是 100%。我们通过连续考虑下一个最长的范围并最终选择最小的模型（最少的层数，然后是注意力头，然后是隐藏维度）来打破剩余的联系。然后将所选的配置用于多种子运行，其中模型在不同的随机模型初始化下进行训练，这是先前工作中常用的方法is 100%. We break remaining ties by successively considering the next-longest ranges and finally preferring the smallest model (fewest layers, then attention heads, then hidden dimension). The chosen configuration was then used for a multi-seed run, in which models were trained under different random model initializations, an approach commonly used in prior work(Li & Cotterell 2025; Huang et al. 2025)。如果运行在分布内测试集上达到 100% 的准确率，则认为运行成功。我们按顺序评估随机初始化，最多进行 1,000 次试验，并在发现 5 次成功运行后结束搜索。我们在图中报告了最成功的种子. A run was considered successful if it achieved 100% accuracy on the in-distribution test set. We evaluated random initializations sequentially, up to a maximum of 1,000 trials, and ended the search once five successful runs were found. We report the best successful seed in Figure3并显示所有成功种子的平均表现and show the average performance across all successful seeds inB.

架构限制。Architectural Constraints.

为了使经验结果与我们的理论设置保持一致，状态预测应该依赖于不断演变的前缀而不是本地信息。 因此，我们引入两个约束：首先，我们通过用零函数（NoPE）替换位置嵌入来删除位置信息，迫使模型依赖于因果注意掩模提供的标记的顺序。 其次，虽然 NoPE 删除了绝对位置信息，但模型仍然可以直接访问最新的输入符号To align empirical results with our theoretical setup, state prediction should depend on the evolving prefix rather than local information. We therefore introduce two constraints: first, we remove positional information by replacing positional embeddings with the zero function (NoPE) forcing the model to rely on the sequential order of tokens provided by the causal attention mask. Second, while NoPE removes absolute positional information, the model still has direct access to the most recent input symbolaia_{i}当预测目标状态时when predicting the target stateqiq_{i}，它通过与预测目标对齐来提供位置信号。 这可以实现模型仅根据最终符号而不是完整前缀来预测状态的快捷方式。 为了防止这种情况，我们插入一个分隔符标记, which provides a positional signal through alignment with the prediction target. This can enable shortcuts in which the model predicts the state based solely on the final symbol, rather than the full prefix. To prevent this, we insert a separator token&\&符号之间（见下文）并要求模型预测状态between symbols (see below) and require the model to predict the stateqiq_{i}仅在这些分隔符位置。因此，对最新符号的访问也是通过注意力机制来调节的。单词符号接收占位符目标only at these separator positions. Consequently, access to the most recent symbol is also mediated through the attention mechanism. Word symbols receive placeholder targets#\#并被排除在交叉熵损失之外。每个目标序列都以初始 DFA 状态开始，在接下来的第一个分隔符处进行预测and are excluded from the cross-entropy loss. Each target sequence begins with the initial DFA state, predicted at the first separator following<老板><bos>.

5.3 结果Results

图Figure3表明shows that𝖢​-​𝖱𝖠𝖲𝖯{\mathsf{C\text{-}RASP}}隶属度是变压器长度泛化的有力预测因子。语言为membership is a strong predictor of transformer length-generalization. Languages in𝖢​-​𝖱𝖠𝖲𝖯{\mathsf{C\text{-}RASP}}可靠地推广到更长的长度，而外部语言generalize reliably to substantially longer lengths, while languages outside𝖢​-​𝖱𝖠𝖲𝖯{\mathsf{C\text{-}RASP}}如果无法做到这一点，准确性会在超出训练长度后迅速下降。这表明在所有评估的语言中fail to do so, with accuracy rapidly collapsing beyond the training length. This demonstrates that across all evaluated languages𝖢​-​𝖱𝖠𝖲𝖯{\mathsf{C\text{-}RASP}}提供长度泛化的准确表征。provides an accurate characterization of length generalization.

6 结论Conclusion

我们使用常规语言成员资格的决策过程精确地描述了变压器长度概括的常规语言We have precisely characterized the regular languages on which transformers length-generalize using a decision procedure for regular language membership in𝖢​-​𝖱𝖠𝖲𝖯{\mathsf{C\text{-}RASP}}（以多项式时间运行）。 对国内外多种语言进行实验(which runs in polynomial-time). Experiments on a range of languages in and outside of𝖢​-​𝖱𝖠𝖲𝖯{\mathsf{C\text{-}RASP}}证明该理论可以准确预测 Transformer 何时进行长度概括以及何时不进行长度概括。 决策过程基于一种新颖的代数分解理论demonstrate that the theory accurately predicts when transformers do and do not length-generalize. The decision procedure is based on a novel algebraic decomposition theory for𝖢​-​𝖱𝖠𝖲𝖯{\mathsf{C\text{-}RASP}}由于包含无限幺半群并省略非周期触发器单元，它与经典克罗恩-罗德理论不同that is distinguished from the classical Krohn-Rhodes theory due to the inclusion of infinite monoids and the omission of the aperiodic flip-flop unitU2{U_{2}}。 一个更简单的标准，对于会员资格来说是必要的（但不是充分的）. A simpler criterion which is necessary (but not sufficient) for membership in𝖢​-​𝖱𝖠𝖲𝖯{\mathsf{C\text{-}RASP}}也以有限方程的形式给出。 我们的结果让我们更深入地了解机器学习方面 Transformer 的状态跟踪功能，以及代数方面对计数的更深入了解。is also given in the form of a profinite equation. Our results provide a deeper understanding of the state-tracking capabilities of transformers on the machine learning front, as well as a deeper understanding of counting, on the algebraic front.

  1. 1.

    问：这项工作与其他工作有何关联和比较？Q: How does the work relate and compare toLiu et al. 2023b?

    Liu et al. 2023b主要着眼于表现力，而不是长度概括。 事实上，他们的实验还证实，变压器可能无法对它们能够表达和学习的特定常规语言进行长度概括，达到固定长度。primarily looked at expressivity, not length generalization. Indeed, their experiments also confirmed that transformers may not length-generalize on the particular regular languages that they were able to express and learn to a fixed length.

    我们的结果也可能适用于特定固定精度假设下变压器的表达能力，因为Our results may also apply to the expressive power of transformers under a particular fixed-precision assumption, because𝖢​-​𝖱𝖠𝖲𝖯{\mathsf{C\text{-}RASP}}被证明与这些变压器等效was shown to be equivalent to these transformers byYang et al. 2025.

  2. 2.

    问：其他架构怎么样？像对数深度转换器、状态空间模型……？Q: How about other architectures? Like log-depth transformers, state-space models, …?

    众所周知，对数深度架构可以模拟任意自动机，因此不需要表征它们可以表达的常规语言It is already known that log-depth architectures can simulate arbitrary automata, so a characterization of the regular languages they can express is not needed(Liu et al. 2023b; Merrill & Sabharwal 2025)。 至于长度泛化，我们目前不知道这些架构在哪些常规语言上进行长度泛化。. As for length-generalization, we do not presently know what regular languages these architectures length-generalize on.

    分析具有有限重复性的架构，例如状态空间模型，将是未来一个有趣的问题。 在不同的假设下，状态空间模型能够模拟触发器和计数Analyzing architectures with limited recurrence, like state-space models, would be an interesting future question. Under varying assumptions, state-space models are able to simulate flip-flops and counting(Sarrof et al. 2024; Alsmann et al. 2026)。 我们开发的用于处理计数的技术也可以扩展到处理这些情况。. The techniques we have developed to handle counting could be extended to handle these cases as well.

  3. 3.

    问：为什么不评估 LLM？Q: Why not evaluate LLMs?

    我们对架构本身更感兴趣。 LLM 能力取决于提示格式，并受到培训数据内容的强烈影响。 有研究表明法学硕士的能力最终受制于We’re more interested in the architecture itself. LLM abilities depend on prompt format and are strongly impacted by what’s in the training data. There is work suggesting that the capabilities of LLMs are ultimately bounded by𝖢​-​𝖱𝖠𝖲𝖯{\mathsf{C\text{-}RASP}} (Jobanputra et al. 2025)，尽管对常规语言长度泛化情况的精确研究超出了本工作的范围。, though a precise investigation in the case of regular language length-generalization is out of the scope of this work.

B.2 更复杂语言的实验Experiments on More Complex Languages

为了测试我们的发现是否扩展到更复杂的语言，我们对系统生成的 50 种具有更大嵌套深度的常规语言集重复了我们的实验（表To test whether our findings extend to more complex languages, we repeat our experiments on a systematically generated set of 50 regular languages with greater nesting depth (Table2），遵循章节中描述的相同实验程序), following the same experimental procedure described in Section5。此外，我们将最大训练长度从 50 增加到 200，使我们能够检查模型在较长字符串上训练时的长度泛化行为。. In addition, we increase the maximum training length from 50 to 200, allowing us to examine length generalization behavior when models are trained on longer strings.

附录EAppendix E类型化幺半群Typed Monoids

Krebs 2008开发了一个使用无限幺半群来识别语言的框架。 我们将上述框架限制在花圈乘积（之前工作中使用的块乘积的单边版本）的情况下，最终提供了精确的代数表征developed a framework for using infinite monoids to recognize languages. We present a restriction of the aforementioned framework to the case of wreath products (a one-sided version of the block product used in previous work), which ultimately provides an exact algebraic characterization of𝖢​-​𝖱𝖠𝖲𝖯{\mathsf{C\text{-}RASP}}。 这里的核心问题是无限幺半群的花环乘积可以生成无数个元素，这可能太强大了。. The core issue here is that the wreath product of infinite monoids can generate uncountably many elements, which can be too powerful.

In essence, this creates a mappingw↦(fw,|w|)w\mapsto(f_{w},|w|)哪里wherefw​(0)f_{w}(0)输出二进制数的整数值outputs the integer value of the binary numberww。 因此，. By computing the nullspace of this basis, we find all possible morphisms that sum to00在循环上，并根据这些态射迭代地关联符号。 最后，辅助函数on loops, and iteratively relable the symbols according to these morphisms.
